title: Illinois data centre project: $18 billion campus gets first permit as neighbours say they learned about it too late
summary_full: Grayslake has granted a building permit for a substantial data-centre campus, representing a major advancement in an $18 billion private investment endeavor. Meanwhile, community members are voicing worries about lack of input and possible environmental repercussions. The developer is committed to thorough community engagement and meeting regulatory guidelines. Site work will be executed in phases, with initial construction about to kick off shortly.
